### Highlights

#### Updates download themselves now

When a new version shows up, the app fetches, verifies and stages it in the background without asking first. There's no "Check for updates" button to remember and no download to sit through: by the time you hear about a release, it's already on disk and one restart away. Restarting is still entirely your call. A download that fails once is retried quietly on the next check instead of being thrown at you as an error.

#### A quieter way to hear about it

The built-in update window is gone. A new version announces itself with a single Windows notification and a small dot on the About tab in the sidebar, so you can finish your game and deal with it later.

#### Update notifications can be turned off

New toggle in Behavior, and a step in first-run setup, for the notification itself. Turning it off doesn't stop updates from downloading, it just stops the toast. Switching it back on later won't replay a notification for a version you already saw.
